summary_en: 2,329,100 shares (1.6% of shares outstanding), ¥12.09 billion upper limit, open-market acquisition on Tokyo Stock Exchange, 9 Jul 2026–31 Mar 2027. Authorization follows strategic partnership with Japan Activation Capital and third-party share allotment; buyback intended to offset dilution from treasury-share disposal.
title_en: Notice of Decision Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 16 June 2026, Hoshizaki Corporation's board authorized the acquisition of up to 2,329,100 treasury shares (1.6% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a maximum total consideration of ¥12.09 billion. Acquisition will occur via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 9 July 2026 and 31 March 2027. This program is being undertaken to mitigate dilution resulting from a third-party allotment of treasury shares that accompanies a newly announced strategic partnership with Japan Activation Capital Corporation. The allotment is intended to support the company's medium- to long-term corporate value maximization and shareholder returns. As of 16 June 2026, the company held 6,485,480 treasury shares; shares outstanding (excluding treasury) totaled 138,404,620.
